title: File chooser
about: One chooser for a file, several files or a folder on a computer. Everything here is sample data held in this page.
open.failed: A folder that cannot be read
startFirst: Stopped. Start it to read its files.
tooBig: Too large to use here (1 MB at most)
limit: Three files at most, each up to 1 MB.
noPreview: No preview for this kind of file.
onlyTs: Only .ts files can be chosen here
findOff: Open a folder first to search below it.
